violation_type.title: Report Change in Director (26 TAC §746.303(a)(4))
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation failed to notify Licensing of a change in director.

finding_variants.text: The operation failed to notify Licensing of a change in director.
The permit holder did not notify Licensing of the change of director.
It was determined that the permit holder failed to provide notification when the center director left their position.

The operation did not notify licensing (Child Care Regulation-CCR) in writing of a change in director within the required time frame. One of the directors no longer works for the operation since June of this year 2024.
The previous Director last day employed was 03/07/2025. Licensing staff was not notified of change until inspection date, 03/27/2025.  A new Director has been hired.
The operation did not report a change in director that occurred October 31st, 2025.
